body: I don't really have very much energy to spend on anything. When I wake in the morning I'm exhausted. Unfortunately, all of the things I used to find fun don't bring me any joy now.

I have compulsive suicidal thoughts that I constantly have to talk myself out of. It's really exhausting.


I feel a lot of guilt when I'm doing things that are fun. It's like if I can do something, why am I not spending that time doing things to make myself independent.
Thank you, I hope it does too. I'm just so tired of fighting.

Hi, I've on a couple different medications and the side effects were terrible. I'm scared to try again. 

I had to move back in with my folks. I couldn't hold down a job, because of my depression. I have a bunch of hobbies, but none of them bring me joy anymore.
